plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Full software-development pipeline: discovery, triage, or received code review, then design dialogue, spec, plan, TDD build, docs hardening. File-based, no tracker.

plugins.name: laravel
plugins.description: Pre-commit quality gates for Laravel projects: run Pint, PHPStan, and your test suite before Claude commits, plus PHPStan feedback after every edit.

plugins.name: skillsmith
plugins.description: Author, test, and audit Claude skills: concise structure, progressive disclosure, degrees of freedom, honest compliance framing, pressure-testing skill discovery and compliance, and an efficiency audit that finds token waste, duplication, costly subagent usage, and dead skills that no longer earn their place.

plugins.name: guardtower
plugins.description: In-depth, opt-in code review gate: a facet menu (Security, Technical, Architectural, and more) fanned out as self-limiting reviewers that relevance-gate, cap, and floor their own findings, write a durable per-facet record under .guardtower/, and never touch your code.

plugins.name: verity
plugins.description: Standalone test-hardening discipline: harden an arbitrary branch via /harden — audit coverage and mutation gaps, write the missing tests, verify their integrity, and measure against thresholds, fanned out as self-limiting audit agents that write a durable run record under .verity/ and never touch application code.
